(`nz/statute/act/public/2018/0032/section/{71,72,74}`). The Schedule 4 Part 8
clause `LMS118454` demonstrates inline pipe-delimited table labels, which
must retain their numeric demands rather than being treated as bare markers.

`property_relationships_s16.txt` is section 16 of the Property (Relationships)
Act 1976 (`nz/statute/act/public/1976/0166/section/16`) from the same release.
It preserves the computation chapeau and its first child operands.

`property_relationships_s1g.txt`, `property_relationships_s20b.txt` and
`property_relationships_s21d.txt` preserve three complete computation excerpts
from the same Act and release. Their punctuation clauses span introductory
text or multiple bare-labelled children, all of which must remain represented

`property_relationships_s45.txt` is section 45 of the same Act
(`nz/statute/act/public/1976/0166/section/45`). Its ambiguous numeric outline

`schedule1_part8_clause93.txt` is Schedule 1 Part 8 clause 93 of the Social

Its detached `Amendment Act` definition tests capitalized definition boundaries.
